CustomField.description: CLAIMS RETIRE, NEVER DELETE. Ruled 6 August 2026, the locked record law reaching the claim ledger. A claim that should never have established anything is marked here rather than removed: the replay skips it, retraction clears whatever map value it carried, and the evidence of the mistake stays readable forever. One-way, enforced in the trigger: a retired claim is never un-retired, because that would make the ledger a thing that can be edited back into a state it was never in. First use: the a21 courtesy claim that reproduced trap-seq11-courtesy and reached Ryan Couture's map row.
CustomField.label: Retired
